task_name: Item write path — create and update with assignment, dates, completed_at and version semantics

strengths: Create and PATCH handlers both wire parseProjectPhase and parseDateRange with 400-before-write validation
endOfBucketPosition scopes by (project_id, phase_id) so created and reassigned items never get NULL position
completed_at on PATCH uses COALESCE(completed_at, now()) matching cards.ts precedent; non-completed targets clear it
Assignment writes bump version; completedAt and position from request body are ignored
16 unit tests cover create/PATCH wiring, error paths, bucket repositioning, and completion stamping
recordTrackerActivity extended to log project, phase, and schedule changes
Scope limited to tracker-items.ts and tracker-items.write.test.ts; commit message matches feat(tracker): …

issues.description: No dedicated test for transition between two completed statuses leaving completed_at unchanged (implementation correct via COALESCE at tracker-items.ts:896)
No explicit test that POST with projectId/phaseId assigns end-of-bucket position in a populated phase bucket (only unassigned-bucket position is asserted)
